title: A university startup cell announces a seed grant

objects.subject: Seed grant applications close 30 Sep
objects.body:
Dear Founder,

Applications for the university seed grant close on 30 Sep. Startups incubated on campus may apply.

University Startup Cell

expected.brief: one line: a grant closing 30 Sep, if you are eligible

not_expressible.cards: brief only — the founder's answer is a line in the morning brief, not a card (D12d)
not_expressible.brief: STEP-15 — there is no morning brief to appear in

notes: The founder's brief names the University Startup Cell as work in motion (a program line, its domain unistartupcell.test), so since STEP-12 (03 F125, yc2_w27_s12 M32.C1.L-contract.V0.U05) its mail is a named sender's: the gate keeps it as W-07 without asking, and it is read. The `gate` and `relevance` above are what those readers would answer if asked; the extraction is what a faithful reader takes from a templated mailing — a grant whose applications close on 30 Sep. Whether the founder is eligible is not in it.
